LANCER_RADIAL.Settings.GmSeesAll.Name: GM sees circles on every actor
LANCER_RADIAL.Settings.GmSeesAll.Hint: Off: the GM only sees slots on tokens a player drives, directly or through the linked pilot. On: every mech, NPC and pilot.
LANCER_RADIAL.Settings.ShowUses.Name: Show the uses counter
LANCER_RADIAL.Settings.ShowUses.Hint: A current/maximum badge on the circle for items carrying the Limited tag.
LANCER_RADIAL.Settings.ShowSafeZone.Name: Highlight the safe zone
LANCER_RADIAL.Settings.ShowSafeZone.Hint: A faint ring around the token inside which the circles stay put. Handy when tuning the radius for your table.
LANCER_RADIAL.Tooltip.Actions: LMB to activate, RMB to reassign
LANCER_RADIAL.Tooltip.Uses: Shift+LMB and Shift+RMB step the counter down and up
LANCER_RADIAL.Tooltip.Fan: Hover to fan out its actions
LANCER_RADIAL.Tooltip.Hub: Basic actions — hover to fan out
LANCER_RADIAL.Dialog.Title: {actor}: slot #{slot}
LANCER_RADIAL.Error.NoPermission: No permission to modify "{actor}". Owner on the actor itself is required, not just on the linked pilot.
LANCER_RADIAL.Error.SaveSlot: Could not save the slot on "{actor}" — most likely a permissions problem.
LANCER_RADIAL.Error.AdjustUses: Could not change the counter on "{item}" — most likely a permissions problem.
